statements.text: Descriptor accounting loses the second word and releases capacity too early. Software reset also misses queues and interrupt state. I’ll fix those reset/accounting paths.

Apply software reset to transfer engine queues and clear operational interrupt/card-qualification state while preserving host programming registers. The descriptor patch failed atomically and remains for a later candidate.

records.summary: 复位修复后，Agent 继续把问题收窄到描述符字存储和活动容量保持；具体接收与释放时机写入了候选提交理由。

statements.text: Reset fixes cut failures from 24,135 to 1,040. I’ll now correct descriptor word storage and capacity retention.
Store each accepted 32-bit descriptor word, launch only complete two-word descriptors, read distinct system/card addresses, and retain capacity for an active descriptor until retirement.

records.summary: Agent 怀疑复位释放后的首个 CMD 阶段计数和重新开始的卡检测资格保持不一致。

statements.text: Only three outputs still fail. Card insertion is one WB cycle early; initial CMD starts counting one SD cycle early. I’ll correct those phase delays first.
Add an explicit reset-release CMD phase before counting initialization clocks, and avoid retaining qualified card presence when qualification has restarted.

records.summary: CMD 复位释放阶段与初始化计数混在一起，SETUP 阶段正常/错误状态也未完整清除。

statements.text: I rolled back the incomplete reset phase. Next I’ll give it explicit outputs and separate DAT reset from CMD watchdog cancellation.
The interrupt pulse comes from SETUP clearing only two bits; spec requires clearing both full status registers. I’ll fix that and CMD reset-phase outputs.
Implement explicit CMD reset-release output phase without decrementing the initialization interval, and clear full normal/error status during SETUP as required by spec.

records.summary: DAT 输出使用了错误的更新边沿，并被 CMD 看门狗取消复位；外部复位后的安静阶段也未保持。

statements.text: Only DAT output remains. I’ll separate its falling-edge pad drive from rising-edge control, preserve the initial quiet phase, and stop CMD timeout from resetting DAT.

DAT waveform shows falling-edge output updates and no reset from CMD watchdog. Split pad drive to falling edge, preserve quiet external-reset phase until request/operational initialization, and separate DAT reset from command cancellation.
